<b>Fluttermites</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are airborne [[Mites|pests]] who are less common than their grounded siblings, the [[Mite]]s.<ref>Fluttermite [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Airborne pest, less common than its grounded siblings."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Fluttermites float up and down aimlessly. When they align horizontally with Hornet, they squeak before lunging forward a short distance in an attempt to deal contact damage.<br>
Fluttermites deal {{Damage|1}} upon contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Fluttermites have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Smell it, starving...
* Deeper, darker...
* Shriek and scratch them...
* Claw and fang...
* Find it. Take it...
* Hide below them...
}}

== Location ==
Fluttermites can be found in [[Greymoor]]. Three of them are located in the cellar of [[Halfway Home]], an area that becomes inaccessible after completing the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Greymoor 4|enemy gauntlet]] that takes place there.
